lines.my_master_sleeps_until_dusk: My master sleeps until dusk. I keep the shutters closed.
lines.i_do_the_errands_by_day: I run all the errands by day. Someone has to.
lines.my_master_is_kind_to_me: My master is kind to me, whatever people say.
lines.i_sleep_in_the_afternoon_now: I sleep in the afternoons now, to keep my master's hours.
